verdict.rationale: Bulk export of traces and datasets is a fair question for an AI observability and evaluation platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented export to blob storage (S3, GCS, Azure) or to a data warehouse. The OpenAPI spec and the MCP dataset-management feature are general building blocks or adjacent features, not a bulk-export capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse
